prompts.title: Table
prompts.prompt: Model a low-poly table: a rectangular tabletop and four legs. Add a Bevel modifier to the tabletop. Keep the whole scene under 1,000 faces.
prompts.caption: a 3D render of a simple table with four legs

prompts.title: Snowman
prompts.prompt: Model a snowman from primitives only: three stacked UV spheres of decreasing size, a cone for the carrot nose and two small spheres for eyes. Keep the whole scene under 3,000 faces.
prompts.caption: a 3D render of a snowman made of three stacked spheres

prompts.title: Low-poly tree
prompts.prompt: Model a stylised low-poly tree: a cylinder trunk with 8 sides and an icosphere canopy with at most 2 subdivisions. Keep the whole scene under 400 faces.
prompts.caption: a 3D render of a low-poly tree with a trunk and a round canopy

prompts.title: Chess pawn
prompts.prompt: Model a chess pawn using primitives only: a wide cylinder base, a torus collar, a tapered cylinder or cone body and a sphere head, all aligned on the Z axis. Keep the whole scene under 3,000 faces.
prompts.caption: a 3D render of a chess pawn

prompts.title: Bookshelf
prompts.prompt: Model a bookshelf: a box frame made of thin cubes with three horizontal shelves. On each shelf place a row of at least 10 thin book-like boxes created with an Array modifier. Keep the whole scene under 2,000 faces.
prompts.caption: a 3D render of a bookshelf with rows of books

prompts.title: Die
prompts.prompt: Model a six-sided die: a cube with rounded edges using a Bevel modifier with 3 segments, and the pips modelled as shallow spheres or cylinders on the faces (1 to 6). Keep the whole scene under 4,000 faces.
prompts.caption: a 3D render of a six-sided die with dots

prompts.title: Rocket
prompts.prompt: Model a low-poly rocket: a cylinder body, a cone nose and three fins made from scaled cubes arranged evenly (120 degrees apart) around the body. Keep the whole scene under 800 faces.
prompts.caption: a 3D render of a toy rocket with three fins

prompts.title: Mug
prompts.prompt: Model a coffee mug: an open-topped cylinder made hollow with a Solidify modifier, and a torus (or half torus) as the handle attached to the side. Keep the whole scene under 3,000 faces.
prompts.caption: a 3D render of a coffee mug with a handle

prompts.title: Fence
prompts.prompt: Model a straight wooden-style fence section: one post duplicated to 8 posts with an Array modifier, and two horizontal rails connecting them. Keep the whole scene under 1,000 faces.
prompts.caption: a 3D render of a fence with posts and rails

prompts.title: House
prompts.prompt: Model a simple low-poly house: a cube for the walls, a four-sided pyramid roof (cone with 4 vertices), a door, and windows placed symmetrically using a Mirror modifier. Keep the whole scene under 500 faces.
prompts.caption: a 3D render of a small house with a pyramid roof

prompts.title: Spiral staircase
prompts.prompt: Procedurally generate a spiral staircase with 24 steps winding around a central cylindrical column: each step rotated 15 degrees and raised relative to the previous one, plus a helical handrail along the outer edge. Total face count between 1,000 and 60,000.
prompts.caption: a 3D render of a spiral staircase around a central column

prompts.title: Terrain
prompts.prompt: Procedurally generate a hilly terrain: a grid of at least 100 x 100 subdivisions whose vertex heights come from a noise function (for example mathutils.noise or a Displace modifier with a Clouds texture). Total face count between 5,000 and 120,000.
prompts.caption: a 3D render of hilly terrain landscape

prompts.title: Lathed vase
prompts.prompt: Create a vase by revolving a 2D profile around the Z axis (for example with a Screw modifier or by building the lathe mesh in Python). It should have a narrow neck, wide body and flat base, with smooth shading and a Subdivision Surface modifier. Total face count between 2,000 and 60,000.
prompts.caption: a 3D render of a smooth vase

prompts.title: Torus knot
prompts.prompt: Generate a (2,3) torus knot as a tube: compute the parametric curve in Python, then give it a circular cross-section (curve bevel or swept mesh). Total face count between 2,000 and 60,000.
prompts.caption: a 3D render of a torus knot

prompts.title: Honeycomb
prompts.prompt: Procedurally generate a honeycomb panel: a 10 x 10 grid of hexagonal prisms with small gaps between cells, correctly offset in alternating rows. Total face count between 600 and 60,000.
prompts.caption: a 3D render of a honeycomb pattern of hexagonal cells

prompts.title: Spur gear
prompts.prompt: Procedurally generate a spur gear with 24 teeth, a thickness of 0.3, and a circular hole through the centre, built as a single mesh using bmesh or vertex/face lists. Total face count between 200 and 60,000.
prompts.caption: a 3D render of a mechanical gear with teeth

prompts.title: Scattered pebbles
prompts.prompt: Using a Geometry Nodes modifier, scatter about 200 small icosphere pebbles of random size and rotation over a 4 x 4 plane (Distribute Points on Faces then Instance on Points). Total face count, including instances, between 5,000 and 150,000.
prompts.caption: a 3D render of many small pebbles scattered on a flat ground

prompts.title: Coil spring
prompts.prompt: Generate a coil spring: a helix with 8 turns, radius 1 and height 4, with a circular wire cross-section (curve bevel or swept tube). Total face count between 2,000 and 60,000.
prompts.caption: a 3D render of a metal coil spring

prompts.title: Rock
prompts.prompt: Create a natural-looking rock: start from an icosphere with at least 4 subdivisions and deform it with a Displace modifier driven by a noise-based texture, with irregular non-uniform scale. Total face count between 2,000 and 60,000.
prompts.caption: a 3D render of a rough natural rock

prompts.title: Chain
prompts.prompt: Generate a chain of 12 interlocking oval links, each link rotated 90 degrees around the chain axis relative to its neighbour so that the links pass through each other. Total face count between 3,000 and 60,000.
prompts.caption: a 3D render of a metal chain with interlocking links

prompts.title: Gold sphere
prompts.prompt: Create a smooth UV sphere with a polished gold material: Principled BSDF with Metallic 1.0, a gold base colour and low roughness. Add a ground plane with a neutral grey material.
prompts.caption: a 3D render of a shiny gold metal sphere

prompts.title: Checker floor
prompts.prompt: Create a floor plane with a black-and-white Checker Texture node driving the Base Color, and a glossy red cube sitting on it.
prompts.caption: a 3D render of a red cube on a black and white checkered floor

prompts.title: Marble
prompts.prompt: Add a Suzanne (monkey) mesh with a white marble material: a Noise or Wave texture fed through a Color Ramp into the Base Color of a Principled BSDF.
prompts.caption: a 3D render of a white marble monkey head sculpture

prompts.title: Glass
prompts.prompt: Create a clear glass sphere (Principled BSDF with full transmission, roughness near 0 and IOR 1.45) resting on a blue ground plane.
prompts.caption: a 3D render of a clear glass sphere on a blue floor

prompts.title: Neon ring
prompts.prompt: Create a glowing cyan neon ring: a torus with an emissive material of emission strength at least 5, above a dark ground plane.
prompts.caption: a 3D render of a glowing cyan neon ring

prompts.title: Wood
prompts.prompt: Create a wooden plank (a scaled cube) with a procedural wood material: a Wave texture distorted by a Noise texture, mapped through a Color Ramp of brown tones into the Base Color, and the same pattern driving a Bump node connected to the Normal input.
prompts.caption: a 3D render of a wooden plank with wood grain

prompts.title: Rusty metal
prompts.prompt: Create a cylinder with a rusty metal material: blend a grey metallic surface with an orange-brown rough rust surface using a Noise texture as the mask (Mix Shader or Mix node).
prompts.caption: a 3D render of a rusty metal cylinder

prompts.title: Brick wall
prompts.prompt: Create a wall (a plane or thin box) with a procedural brick material using the Brick Texture node for colour, and the mortar pattern driving a Bump or Displacement node.
prompts.caption: a 3D render of a red brick wall

prompts.title: Car paint
prompts.prompt: Create a sphere with a deep red car-paint material: Principled BSDF with metallic around 0.5 and a strong clear coat (coat weight at least 0.8).
prompts.caption: a 3D render of a glossy red car paint sphere

prompts.title: Multi-material cube
prompts.prompt: Create a cube with three different coloured materials (red, green and blue) assigned to different faces of the same mesh using material slots and face material indices.
prompts.caption: a 3D render of a cube with red, green and blue faces
